Card C09241-K2 has 20 prior confirmed fraud cases, including account_takeover, card_not_present_fraud, and out_of_region_use patterns, with the most recent case CC-5469 closed on 2016-10-30.
Transaction 3640919 ($881.55, in-person) is part of a 43-transaction episode totaling $4440.09, which includes both in-person and online activity from 2017-01-13 to 2017-01-20.

Card C09241-K2 is associated with the strong device profile 'Windows | Windows 7 | firefox 57.0 | 1280x800', which has 10 prior fraud cases and was active on 11 cards (including C09241-K2) prior to the case opening.
The flagged transaction 3640919 occurred in region 494.0, which is known to card C09241-K2 with 492 prior transactions over 178 days, while the card's modal region is 441.0.
Card C09241-K2 has one prior risk-score alert (CC-1257) that was cleared with an outcome of 'none' after the customer confirmed the activity.
The calibrated cms_p for transaction 3640919 is low (0.0157), and the scorer is considered unreliable for card C09241-K2 due to its high transaction count (6864).
Assumed reply: customer confirmed travel to billing region 494.0 and recognises the $881.55 purchase

case.summary: The verdict is legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.1. The initial flagged $881.55 in-person transaction (ID 3640919) was part of a 43-transaction episode totaling $4440.09 and was initially considered account takeover given the card's 20 prior fraud cases and a shared strong device profile. However, a customer validation request confirmed travel to the region and recognized the purchase. The recommended actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD (auto routes).
